name: Error (novella)
source:
The return of Error in a different genre and style - now a Visual Novel!
The basic concept of the game Error was taken as a basis, but greatly supplemented.

[From [url=https://awupetiki-games.itch.io/error]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Error》以不同的类型与风格回归——这次是一部视觉小说！
本作以原版《Error》的核心概念为基础，并进行了大幅扩充。

[摘自[url=https://awupetiki-games.itch.io/error]Itch.io[/url]]
